name: The Hollywood Christmas Village at Hollywood Community Church
paras: Hollywood Community Church lists The Hollywood Christmas Village on its events calendar for Friday, December 11, 2026 from 6 to 9 PM, and marks entry free.
The church describes an evening of Christmas lights, food trucks, games and s'mores around the fire pit.
The host also lists an immersive walkthrough that tells the story of Christmas, and invites the whole family.
The church's calendar places the event at its campus at 1708 N State Rd 7 in Hollywood.
